conditions.today: 6 AM- Rise and greet a gorgeous spring morning, Jackson. Our space-bound stone is spinning us towards another sun-sational day of soft-snow shredding. Positive and negative G-forces will be yours for the taking as we carve under near bluebird skies that push temperatures close to record-breaking. Highs will reach the mid-40s on the deck of Corbet's Cabin as Teton Village continues to court the upper 60s. Gusty winds will be blowing from the west-southwest between 5 and 25 mph, with the upper elevations seeing gusts into the 30s. The heatwave rays continue, but let's be honest, you don't mind feelin' em. Because that's the moment when you fall into a sweet daydream delirium. -Lege
conditions.yesterday: 6 AM- Make plans for a moody Tuesday in the mountains, Jackson Hole. Patchy cloud cover blown by moderate winds will move strange shadows across the white forest floor, enticing you to taste a tiny piece of something slightly off-piste. Go for it and add an extra aspect of adventure to the day. A fast-moving shower may make a surprise appearance but shouldn't disrupt any of your on-slope play, because warm temperatures will welcome you all along the way. Expect the summit to soar near 40 degrees while Teton Village pushes close to 60. Gusty winds from the west will be whistling through the trees and crags as they blow between 5 and 30 mph. Enjoy the continuing cascade of contrasts. -Lege
